title: MaxDNA
description: MAXGEN 2.0 -- One MaxDNA document is one person's DNA test and its matches, always tier2-private, holding no raw genotype data and no raw kit number (only keyed fingerprints), with each match a claim that cites the saved match list.

dna_id.description: Random id of this DNA test document, created once by its writer and never reused.

person_id.description: The MaxPerson who took this test (the one top-level key MaxDNA shares with MaxPerson; the kind is decided by dna_id first).

test_type.description: Type of DNA test: unknown when the source does not say (an imported DNA table may not), other with test_type_as_written.

test_type_as_written.description: The source's own words for the test type, written when test_type is other.

test_provider.description: Company or platform that performed or hosts the original test (other with test_provider_as_written).

test_provider_as_written.description: The source's own name for the provider, written when test_provider is other.

test_date.description: When the test was taken, as a date block (a year alone is fine).

kit_id_status.description: Whether the kit number's fingerprint is known: hashed (the default when left out) requires kit_id_hash; unknown when the source gave no kit number.

kit_id_hash.description: Keyed fingerprint (HMAC-SHA-256 keyed with the database's own secret kit_key, not a plain SHA-256) of the kit number, trimmed and upper-cased; the kit makes it with `maxgen_db.py kit-hash`; the raw kit number is never stored.

kit_source.description: Where this test's details came from, in plain words (for example user_self_report, opensnp_public or an imported tree file).

haplogroup_y.description: Y-DNA haplogroup (paternal line) as the provider reported it, for example R-M269.

haplogroup_mt.description: mtDNA haplogroup (maternal line) as the provider reported it, for example H1a1.

haplogroup_y_confidence.description: The provider's own confidence in the Y-DNA haplogroup, 0 to 1, kept as reported.

haplogroup_mt_confidence.description: The provider's own confidence in the mtDNA haplogroup, 0 to 1, kept as reported.

ancestry_composition.description: Ethnicity or admixture estimates as the provider reported them; they add up to about 100 percent.

endogamy_flag.description: True if the test subject belongs to an endogamous population, where the usual shared-cM ranges are unreliable.

endogamy_population.description: The endogamous population, in plain words, when endogamy_flag is true.

matches.description: The matches reported for this test, each a claim citing the saved match list; a match between two tests in this database is stored once, on the test with the smaller dna_id (R-25).

kit_aliases.description: The same kit's ids at other services, as keyed fingerprints only (replaces the 1.x external_ids map).

is_living_flag.description: Living A: true if the test subject may be alive, and true when unsure; a floor the kit only raises.

redistribution_license.description: Always tier2-private: genetic data touches relatives who never agreed to share it, so no other value is accepted.

raw_genotype_stored.description: Always false: MAXGEN never stores raw genotype data (FASTQ, VCF or raw SNP files); that stays with the provider or the person.

external_raw_data_location.description: Plain words saying where the raw data is held (for example the person's own drive or the provider account); never a raw kit number, a genotype or an unhashed id.

consent_status.description: Legal basis for keeping this DNA data: the first four values are consent; withdrawn, pending, unknown (an import that does not say) and any value the kit does not know are read as not consented, so the test is shown only on the owner's own pages.

consent_evidence_url.description: Address of the signed consent record, kept somewhere private.

withdrawal_requested_at.description: When the test subject asked for this DNA data to be withdrawn.

source_record_ids.description: MaxRecords that document this test (a saved provider page, a consent form, a lab report); replaces the 1.x source_records.

match.description: One DNA match, built on the claim header: it carries a status, a task, an evidence link (the saved match list or match page, normally basis document with the match's own line as mention_id) and a confidence.

match_id.description: Permanent id of this match, cited by evidence match_ids and by triangulated_with; the helper fills it when absent and never changes it.

match_kit_hash.description: Keyed fingerprint of the matching kit's number, made like kit_id_hash (kit-hash); one of match_kit_hash and match_dna_id is required.

match_dna_id.description: The other MaxDNA test, when both tests are in this database; one of match_kit_hash and match_dna_id is required.

match_person_id.description: The MaxPerson who took the matching test, when that person is in this database.

match_display_name.description: The match's display name or handle as the service showed it; it may be a pseudonym.

is_living.description: Living A for the matched person: true if they may be alive, and true when unsure.

shared_cm.description: Total shared centimorgans across all segments (up to 7000, which admits identical twins).

weighted_cm.description: Shared centimorgans after the provider's own weighting or filtering, as reported.

percent_shared.description: Share of DNA in common, in percent, as reported.

longest_segment_cm.description: Length of the longest shared segment in centimorgans (up to 285, a whole chromosome 1).

cm_map_version.description: Which genetic map produced the cM values; different maps give totals that cannot be compared.

phasing_status.description: Which parent's side the shared segments fall on: unphased when no phasing was tried, unknown when it was tried without result.

match_source.description: Where this match was reported (other with match_source_as_written).

match_source_as_written.description: The source's own name for where the match was reported, written when match_source is other.

predicted_relationships.description: The relationships the provider or a tool predicted for this match, each with its reported probability (replaces the 1.x inferred_relationship and relationship_confidence).

chromosome_segments.description: The individual shared segments, for triangulation; may be left out when only totals are known.

triangulated_with.description: The match_ids of other matches on this same test that share the same segment.

common_ancestor_candidates.description: MaxPersons who may be the most recent common ancestor with this match; several are allowed and no score is stored.

predicted_relationship.description: One predicted relationship for a match, as reported.

relationship.description: The predicted relationship category (other with relationship_as_written).

relationship_as_written.description: The predictor's own words for the relationship, written when relationship is other.

probability_as_reported.description: The probability the predictor gave, 0 to 1, kept as reported and never computed by the kit.

source_as_written.description: Who or what made the prediction, in its own words (for example the provider's match page or a named calculator).

chromosome.description: The chromosome the segment is on; a segment on a chromosome name the kit does not know is ignored.

start_position.description: Genome start position of the segment (in the build named by build_version).

end_position.description: Genome end position of the segment (in the build named by build_version).

start_cm.description: Genetic start position of the segment in centimorgans.

end_cm.description: Genetic end position of the segment in centimorgans.

snp_count.description: Number of SNPs in the segment.

build_version.description: The reference genome build of start_position and end_position (other with build_version_as_written).

build_version_as_written.description: The source's own name for the genome build, written when build_version is other.

common_ancestor_candidate.description: One MaxPerson who may be the most recent common ancestor with a match.

inference_method.description: How the candidate was found (other with inference_method_as_written).

inference_method_as_written.description: The writer's own words for how the candidate was found, written when inference_method is other.

ancestry_component.description: One ethnicity or admixture estimate as the provider reported it.

region.description: The region label exactly as the provider reported it.

confidence.description: The provider's own confidence in this estimate, 0 to 1, kept as reported.

iso_country_codes.description: Two-letter country codes the region maps to.

kit_alias.description: The same kit's id at another service, as a keyed fingerprint only.

system.description: The other service, in lower case (for example gedmatch or ftdna).

id_hash.description: Keyed fingerprint of the kit's id at that service; the raw id is never stored.
